asked.item: Does Tolt's 'Earn 50% on all paid customers' mean half of every month for a referred monthly Creator customer

verdict.reason: The pages say the Tolt message is generic and the commission is only on the first payment.

steps.text: No, the message "Earn 50% on all paid customers." is generic Tolt text.
It does not mean you receive commission on every recurring subscription payment.
Blotato's standard commission is 50% of the referred customer's first payment only, and for a monthly subscription that first payment is the monthly charge.
